aliases: Abnormal monitor switch operation

properties.name: Abnormal interlock monitor switch operation
properties.description: Abnormal interlock monitor switch operation

evidence.text: C. MONITOR SWITCH TEST

Disconnect the wire lead from the monitor switch. Connect the ohmmeter leads to the common (COM) and normally closed (NC) terminals of the switch. The meter should indicate a closed circuit in the door open condition. If the door is closed, the meter should indicate an open circuit. If the monitor switch operation is abnormal, replace it with the same type of switch. NOTE: After repairing the door or the interlock system, it is necessary to do this continuity test before operating the oven.

nodes.name: Abnormal primary interlock switch operation

properties.name: Abnormal primary interlock switch operation
properties.description: Abnormal primary interlock switch operation

evidence.text: A. PRIMARY INTERLOCK SWITCH TEST

When the door is opened slowly, an audible click should be heard at the same time or successively at intervals and the latches should activate the switches with an audible click. If the latches do not activate the switches when the door is closed, the switches should be adjusted in accordance with the adjustment procedure. Disconnect the wire lead from the primary switch. Connect the ohmmeter leads to the common (COM) and normally open (NO) terminal of the switch. The meter should indicate an open circuit in the door open condition. When the door is closed, the meter should indicate a closed circuit.
If the primary switch operation is abnormal, make the necessary adjustment or replace the switch, making sure to replace it with the same type of switch.

evidence.text: B. SECONDARY INTERLOCK SWITCH TEST

Disconnect the wire lead from the secondary switch. Connect the ohmmeter leads to the common (COM) and normally open (NO) terminals of the switch. The meter should indicate an open circuit in the door open condition. When the door is closed, the meter should indicate a closed circuit. If the secondary switch operation is abnormal, make the necessary adjustment or replace the switch, making sure to replace it with the same type of switch.

evidence.text: A. PRIMARY INTERLOCK SWITCH TEST

When the door is opened slowly, an audible click should be heard at the same time or successively at intervals and the latches should activate the switches with an audible click. If the latches do not activate the switches when the door is closed, the switches should be adjusted in accordance with the adjustment procedure. Disconnect the wire lead from the primary switch. Connect the ohmmeter leads to the common (COM) and normally open (NO) terminal of the switch. The meter should indicate an open circuit in the door open condition. When the door is closed, the meter should indicate a closed circuit.
If the primary switch operation is abnormal, make the necessary adjustment or replace the switch, making sure to replace it with the same type of switch.

When the door is opened slowly, an audible click should be heard at the same time or successively at intervals and the latches should activate the switches with an audible click. If the latches do not activate the switches when the door is closed, the switches should be adjusted in accordance with the adjustment procedure. Disconnect the wire lead from the primary switch. Connect the ohmmeter leads to the common (COM) and normally open (NO) terminal of the switch. The meter should indicate an open circuit in the door open condition. When the door is closed, the meter should indicate a closed circuit.
If the primary switch operation is abnormal, make the necessary adjustment or replace the switch, making sure to replace it with the same type of switch.

Disconnect the wire lead from the secondary switch. Connect the ohmmeter leads to the common (COM) and normally open (NO) terminals of the switch. The meter should indicate an open circuit in the door open condition. When the door is closed, the meter should indicate a closed circuit. If the secondary switch operation is abnormal, make the necessary adjustment or replace the switch, making sure to replace it with the same type of switch.

Disconnect the wire lead from the monitor switch. Connect the ohmmeter leads to the common (COM) and normally closed (NC) terminals of the switch. The meter should indicate a closed circuit in the door open condition. If the door is closed, the meter should indicate an open circuit. If the monitor switch operation is abnormal, replace it with the same type of switch. NOTE: After repairing the door or the interlock system, it is necessary to do this continuity test before operating the oven.
